# Kenney Minigolf Kit 3.1

Creator: Kenney — https://kenney.nl

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/minigolf-kit

Archive: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/minigolf-kit/3ae60d8b01-1741163874/kenney_minigolf-kit.zip

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public-domain dedication). Original license is retained in `License.txt` and packaged in Android assets.

Selected editable OBJ/MTL sources and their palette texture are retained here. `scripts/convert_models.py` triangulates faces, grounds/centers the models and bakes the palette color into vertices, producing bundled `.mesh` files. Source geometry remains recognizable and is scaled/placed in the native OpenGL renderer.

Models used: ball-blue, flags, open course tile, obstacle-block, castle, structure-windmill, structure-gate. Additional included conversion sources: windmill and obstacle-diamond.

Range targets, architecture, trees, game rules, and simplified collision geometry are authored in this project. The games are not affiliated with Topgolf or Kenney.
